The '''Orimanther system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Orimanther]], which was home to flocks of [[battlebird]]s.<ref name="A Mon Alone" />
